O.outcome_detail: estimate of the synchronization transition threshold Kc

cells.quote: "As shown in Fig. 26, the distribution of theK c estimate done by 106 students (with additional 6 “not remembering” null answers) is peaked around reasonable values (0.6≤K c ≤0.75), indicating that most of students understood the game."
cells.note: The supplied study text excerpt does not include the Fig. 26 sentence; the quote is reproduced from the wiki entry as permitted when the study text is unavailable. The finding is descriptive and reports no comparison condition or inferential test.
